source.docs: The repository is the source of truth. This catalog points at it; it never duplicates a procedure.
source.versions: compatibility/version-matrix.md — parsed at build time, so a version bump propagates without touching this file.
source.adr: decisions/ADR-*.md — the reasoning behind every option below.

methods.title: Bare metal
methods.summary: Physical servers, direct disk for storage and etcd, full control of the PCIe and NUMA topology.
methods.bestFor: Ceph at scale, GPU inference, predictable IO latency, no hypervisor in the failure path.
requirements: IPMI or BMC access for out-of-band installation
Local SSD for etcd, dedicated NVMe for Ceph journal and OSD DB
RAID1 for the boot disk, or software RAID managed by the OS baseline

methods.title: Virtual machines
methods.summary: VMs on an existing hypervisor, with the caveats below.
methods.bestFor: Small sites, environments where hardware is not available, fast proof of concept.
requirements: Ceph OSD disks must be raw or SCSI-passthrough, never a shared virtual disk
etcd must sit on a local SSD with local vCPUs, not on shared storage
GPU workloads need passthrough; MIG is not virtualizable, so the whole card must be passed through
The hypervisor becomes part of the failure domain and must be in the DR plan

clusterMethods.title: Kubespray (Ansible)
clusterMethods.summary: Version-pinned inventory, idempotent, offline-capable, five releases supported in parallel.

options.title: Oracle Linux 8
options.warning: Kernel 4.18 is below the 4.19 recommendation in the Kubespray kernel matrix.

options.title: 5 control-plane nodes, stacked etcd
options.warning: Longer maintenance windows and a third failure domain needed to justify it.

options.title: Calico — mature, rich policy, IPIP/VXLAN
options.note: The Calico deployment details live in the Kubespray inventory for the pinned release.

options.title: Ceph via cephadm on dedicated hosts, consumed over the external CSI driver
HAProxy (L4, active health checks) + Nginx (L7, TLS), Keepalived, Docker Compose
Nginx only (L4 passthrough + L7), Keepalived, Docker Compose
F5 NGINX Gateway Fabric (Gateway API native)
Envoy Gateway (Gateway API native, second implementation)
OpenBao (MPL 2.0)
options.note: The deployment model is portable from Vault. Use this when the BSL is not acceptable.

options.title: Velero with CSI snapshots to object storage
GPU workers with MIG isolation, vLLM serving
Istio ambient (ztunnel per node, waypoints only where L7 is needed)
options.note: Lower per-pod cost, but a ztunnel fault affects every pod on the node.

options.title: Istio sidecar (Envoy per pod)
options.warning: Adopt only when the threshold in service-mesh/evaluation.md is met. This adds a control plane and a new failure domain.

steps.title: Confirm the requirements, assumptions and open decisions
actions: Close every open decision D-01..D-14
Confirm the site IP plan and the failure domains
Confirm the legal position on the Vault license

steps.title: Read the architecture and the decisions
actions: Review the architecture overview
Review the failure-domain table for the components you selected

steps.title: Stand up the internal repositories and mirror every artifact
actions: Deploy Harbor and Nexus
Run the staging workflow for every component you selected
Verify offline package install, image pull and chart deploy on a throwaway node

steps.title: DNS, NTP, network, PKI, identity, load balancing
actions: Deploy DNS and NTP
Create the internal CA and distribute the trust bundle
Deploy the edge load balancer
Implement the firewall rules from the matrix

steps.title: Automation Management Server, Ansible, AWX, GitLab, Vault
actions: Install Ansible in a virtualenv with the pinned version
Deploy AWX and register the runners
Deploy Vault on dedicated hosts and test the unseal procedure

steps.title: Provision and harden the nodes
actions: Configure the internal repositories
Apply sysctl, kernel modules and the security baseline
Join the directory, if selected
Install the monitoring and logging agents

steps.title: Deploy the storage platform
actions: Create the CRUSH map with the host failure domain
Create the pools, the filesystem and the object store
Check Ceph HEALTH_OK before consuming any PVC

steps.title: Deploy the cluster with Kubespray
actions: Fill the inventory and the group vars
Mirror the artifacts for the selected Kubespray release
Run cluster.yml, then validate the control plane and etcd

steps.title: CNI, ingress, load balancing, CSI
actions: Install the CNI and confirm kube-proxy replacement
Configure MetalLB and the ingress controller
Configure the CSI driver and the StorageClasses
Apply the Gateway API CRDs

steps.title: Deploy Istio and enable mTLS in stages
actions: Confirm the adoption threshold in service-mesh/evaluation.md is actually met
Extract and mirror every image the install and the dataplane need
Decide the dataplane mode: ambient (per node) or sidecar (per pod)
Install the control plane with Helm so Argo CD owns it
Apply PeerAuthentication STRICT to one namespace, watch the metrics, then continue
Apply the default-deny AuthorizationPolicy only after the allow rules exist
Test a negative case: a pod that should be denied must be denied
Wire Istio telemetry into the existing Prometheus stack

steps.title: Rancher, Keycloak, Argo CD, backup
actions: Install Rancher and register the Application Cluster
Wire Keycloak OIDC and verify the groups claim
Install Argo CD and sync the first application
Install Velero and run a first backup

steps.title: Vault integration, admission policy, runtime detection
actions: Bind the Vault role to the service account
Deploy the admission controllers in audit mode, then enforce
Enable the runtime detection ruleset
Verify certificate renewal and secret rotation

steps.title: Metrics, alerting, logs
actions: Install the monitoring stack and confirm every target is up
Configure the alert routes and the runbook links
Deploy the log pipeline and prove the redaction filter

steps.title: GPU workers, driver, sharing, serving
actions: Install the driver and the GPU Operator
Configure MIG and verify the isolation
Mirror the model weights and start the inference server
Validate the DCGM metrics

steps.title: Pipelines, approval gates, drift detection
actions: Wire the 14 pipeline stages
Protect the branches and require the approvals
Turn on the nightly drift job

steps.title: Upgrades, backups, restore, disaster recovery
actions: Run the upgrade procedure on a staging copy
Restore into a scratch namespace and measure the RTO
Rebuild a node from the OS and Kubespray
Exercise the full rebuild order offline

steps.title: Acceptance tests and handover
actions: Execute every acceptance test and store the evidence
Record the known limitations
Hand over to the operations team

upgradeSections.title: Before any upgrade
actions: Confirm the target version is in the version matrix
Confirm the compatibility constraints for the component
Mirror the target artifacts and pull-verify them
Take and verify a backup
Check the end-of-life watchlist for a forced exit

upgradeSections.title: Kubernetes and Kubespray
actions: One minor version at a time
Control plane first, then the workers
Run the target release's own virtualenv
Kubernetes has no rollback: the restore path is the backup

upgradeSections.title: Ceph and Rook-Ceph
actions: Rook operator first, then Ceph, then the CSI driver
The Rook release constrains the Ceph version
Ceph has no rollback across a major version

upgradeSections.title: Helm 3 to Helm 4
actions: Helm 3 security fixes end 2027-02-10
Install Helm 4 alongside Helm 3
Re-run every chart operation under Helm 4
Keep the Helm 3 binary until the date passes

upgradeSections.title: Edge load balancer
actions: Update the image tags in the Compose file
Upgrade one node, verify, then the other
Confirm the VRRP state and the health checks after each node

upgradeSections.title: GPU operator, driver and CUDA
actions: Drain one GPU node at a time
Verify the driver, the toolkit and the operator versions line up
Run nvidia-smi on the node and in a pod before uncordoning

upgradeSections.title: Ingress controller portfolio
actions: Check the deprecation stage of each controller
Upstream retirement forces Deprecated immediately
Migrate the traffic share before removing a controller

upgradeSections.title: Service mesh (Istio)
actions: One minor version at a time; Istio does not support skipping minors
Install the new revision alongside the old one (canary control plane)
Move namespaces one at a time by changing the istio.io/rev label, then restart
Rollback exists only while the old revision is installed: move the label back
Downgrade is not supported. Remove the old revision only after every namespace has moved
Confirm the Kubernetes version window for the target Istio minor before starting

upgradeSections.title: Vault and the PKI
actions: Snapshot the raft storage before the upgrade
Upgrade the standby, then the active
Verify the unseal procedure and the audit device after the upgrade

exports.name: Keepalived configuration for the edge
exports.description: VRRP instance for the edge VIP. Unicast peers, because the DMZ VLAN is assumed to filter multicast.

exports.name: Docker Compose stack for the edge
exports.description: The edge dataplane and VRRP, on the host network.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Dataplane: {{choice.edge}}
name: edge

services:
  haproxy:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/haproxy:{{version.haproxy}}
    container_name: edge-haproxy
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./haproxy.cfg:/usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/haproxy/certs:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "haproxy", "-c", "-f", "/usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

  nginx:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/nginx:{{version.nginx}}
    container_name: edge-nginx
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "nginx", "-t"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

  keepalived:
    image: {{value.registryHost}}/edge/keepalived:{{version.keepalived}}
    container_name: edge-keepalived
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - NET_BROADCAST
      - NET_RAW
      - SYS_MODULE
    volumes:
      - ./keepalived.conf:/etc/keepalived/keepalived.conf:ro
      - ./keepalived.d:/etc/keepalived/keepalived.d:ro
    pid: host
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind: "1"

exports.name: Edge node bootstrap script
exports.description: Prepares one edge node: kernel settings, directories, images, stack start. Run on both nodes.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Edge nodes: {{value.edgeNodes}}   VIP: {{value.edgeVip}}
set -euo pipefail

REGISTRY="{{value.registryAddr}}"
STACK_DIR=/opt/edge

# 1. Non-local bind, so the dataplane can listen on the VIP before it moves.
cat >/etc/sysctl.d/90-edge.conf <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.ip_nonlocal_bind = 1
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
EOF
sysctl --system

# 2. Unicast VRRP only. The DMZ VLAN is assumed to filter 224.0.0.18.
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-rich-rule='rule protocol value="vrrp" accept' || true
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8404/tcp || true
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8443/tcp || true
firewall-cmd --reload || true

# 3. Install the runtime from the internal mirror, never from the internet.
dnf install -y docker-ce docker-compose-plugin || \
  apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2
systemctl enable --now docker

# 4. Stack directory and the generated files.
install -d -m 0750 "$STACK_DIR" "$STACK_DIR/certs" "$STACK_DIR/keepalived.d"
# Copy docker-compose.yml, haproxy.cfg, nginx.conf, keepalived.conf and
# keepalived.d/* into $STACK_DIR before starting the stack.

# 5. Pull from the internal registry, then start.
cd "$STACK_DIR"
docker compose pull
docker compose up -d

# 6. Verify.
docker compose ps
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'edge health: %{http_code}\n' https://{{value.edgeVip}}/healthz || true

exports.name: Kubespray run script
exports.description: Runs the pinned release from its own checkout and virtualenv, offline, against the generated inventory.
exports.template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Release: {{choice.kubespray}}   Kubernetes: {{version.kubernetes}}
set -euo pipefail

RELEASE="{{choice.kubespray}}"
BASE=/opt/kubespray
SRC="$BASE/$RELEASE"
INV="$BASE/inventory/{{value.clusterName}}-{{value.env}}"

# One checkout and one virtualenv per release. Never share them across releases:
# the Ansible and Python pins differ.
test -d "$SRC" || { echo "missing checkout: $SRC"; exit 1; }
test -d "$INV" || { echo "missing inventory: $INV"; exit 1; }

cd "$SRC"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$BASE/venv-$RELEASE/bin/activate"

ansible --version

# Offline: every image and binary resolves through the internal mirror.
ansible-playbook -i "$INV/hosts.ini" cluster.yml \
  -b --become-user=root \
  -e @"$INV/group_vars/all/offline.yml" \
  -e kube_version="{{version.kubernetes}}" \
  "$@"

# Validate before handing the cluster over.
kubectl --kubeconfig "$INV/artifacts/admin.conf" get nodes -o wide
kubectl --kubeconfig "$INV/artifacts/admin.conf" -n kube-system get pods

exports.name: Istio install manifest (IstioOperator)
exports.description: Control plane pinned to the mirrored registry. Revision-based, so a canary upgrade is possible.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Istio {{version.istio}}   Mode: {{choice.serviceMesh}}
apiVersion: install.istio.io/v1alpha1
kind: IstioOperator
metadata:
  name: istio-{{revision}}
  namespace: istio-system
spec:
  profile: {{istioProfile}}
  revision: "{{revision}}"
  hub: {{value.registryHost}}/istio
  tag: "{{version.istio}}"
  meshConfig:
    accessLogFile: /dev/stdout
    enablePrometheusMerge: true
    defaultConfig:
      terminationDrainDuration: 30s
  components:
    pilot:
      k8s:
        replicas: 2
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: 500m, memory: 2Gi}
    ingressGateways:
      - name: istio-ingressgateway
        enabled: true
        k8s:
          hpaSpec:
            minReplicas: 2
            maxReplicas: 6
  values:
    global:
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      proxy:
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi}
          limits: {cpu: "1", memory: 512Mi}

exports.name: mTLS and authorization policies
exports.description: STRICT mTLS per namespace, default-deny, and the allow rules. Apply the deny rule only after the allows exist.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
# Stage 1: permissive is the install default. Apply STRICT one namespace at a time,
# watch the mesh metrics for rejected connections, then continue.
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: PeerAuthentication
metadata:
  name: default
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec:
  mtls:
    mode: STRICT
---
# Stage 2: default deny. Apply only after the allow rules below are in place.
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec: {}
---
# Stage 3: allow in-namespace traffic.
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-same-namespace
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec:
  action: ALLOW
  rules:
    - from:
        - source:
            namespaces: ["{{value.appNamespace}}"]
---
# Stage 4: allow the ingress gateway namespace to reach the workload.
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-ingress
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec:
  action: ALLOW
  rules:
    - from:
        - source:
            namespaces: ["istio-ingress"]

exports.name: Gateway API route through the mesh
exports.description: One GatewayClass claim per hostname. Do not run this in front of a hostname another controller already serves.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
# Istio {{version.istio}}   Host: app.{{value.domain}}
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: istio-gateway
  namespace: istio-ingress
spec:
  gatewayClassName: istio
  listeners:
    - name: https
      port: 443
      protocol: HTTPS
      hostname: "app.{{value.domain}}"
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - kind: Secret
            name: app-tls
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: {{value.appNamespace}}
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: istio-gateway
      namespace: istio-ingress
  hostnames: ["app.{{value.domain}}"]
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path: {type: PathPrefix, value: /}
      backendRefs:
        - name: app
          port: 8080

exports.name: vLLM inference deployment
exports.description: OpenAI-compatible inference server with the model cache on local NVMe.
exports.template:
# Generated by the cloud-native guide site
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vllm
  namespace: ai
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: vllm}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: vllm}
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu: "true"
      tolerations:
        - key: nvidia.com/gpu
          operator: Equal
          value: "true"
          effect: NoSchedule
      containers:
        - name: vllm
          image: {{value.registryHost}}/platform/vllm:{{version.vllm}}
          args:
            - "--model=/models/model"
            - "--served-model-name=llama"
            - "--port=8000"
            - "--tensor-parallel-size=1"
            - "--gpu-memory-utilization=0.90"
            - "--max-model-len=8192"
            - "--trust-remote-code=false"
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          resources:
            limits:
              nvidia.com/gpu: 1
          volumeMounts:
            - {name: model-cache, mountPath: /models}
      volumes:
        - name: model-cache
          hostPath: {path: /mnt/models, type: DirectoryOrCreate}
